description: Seed artists for the reference catalog. Chosen to span regions, scripts, eras and genres (hip-hop, R&B, pop, jazz, electronic, rock, Afrobeats, K-pop, Latin, MPB, Bollywood, Arabic classical) so that cross-genre and cross-region paths and bridge artists exist, and so non-Latin names are exercised end to end. Names are resolved to MusicBrainz IDs by `songnexus fetch`; pin `mbid` when the resolver reports an ambiguous name. Every pinned mbid carries a pin_reason recording the human decision.
